title: precheck's lead-in warning misses a research goal whose lead-in ends with a colon and a line break or two spaces before (1)
goal: precheck warns of a goal research story whose lead-in joins its first question whatever whitespace stands between the colon and the number

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land as L
lead='Research with the kb tools first and the live docs for gaps, written as kb facts and gap entries through /kb-research:'
r=[L.joined_lead_in(lead+sep+'(1) Which option?') for sep in ('\n','  ')]
print([bool(x) for x in r]);sys.exit(0 if all(r) else 1)

clauses.clause: precheck warns of a goal research story whose lead-in joins its first question whatever whitespace stands between the colon and the number

notes: Goal before the 2026-10-17 plan: SP-aoiqmnc6 review G6 (ST-7kl5dnwr): joined_lead_in looks for the lead-in followed by ': ' and the number with one space, so a goal research story whose lead-in ends ':\n(1)' or ':  (1)' gets no warning although goal_questions still joins the lead-in to the first question in both shapes. precheck warns of such a lead-in whatever whitespace stands between the colon and the number. Plan 2026-10-17: repro on origin/main b871374b4 exits 1 ([False, False] for a line break and two spaces). Runs after BG-lgzf4rw7 (same module, the same lead-in rule).
